sentences.en: That is the task that I have been engaged in, falteringly , in the years since then: polishing the jewel of my own being to allow its natural radiance and beauty to shine through.

sentences.en: She pointed the direction, and Mr. Button, bathed in cool perspiration, turned falteringly, and began to mount to the second floor.

sentences.en: Here the child's voice lost its self-possessed note and became falteringly human.
